run_interactive_web_server: run the interactive web server on localhost:8080 to chat with a ParlAI model
setup_interactive: set up the interactive script by parsing args, loading a model, and creating an agent
interactive_running: generate a model response given a personality and base64-encoded image via the MyHandler class
do_POST_interact: handle POST requests to the /interact endpoint with personality and image data
do_GET_web_ui: handle GET requests to serve the interactive web UI HTML page
